_readme: S487 SkyHuckleberry, 2026-10-26. General Studies: Arts and Humanities A.A. 17912 (AA.GAH) fails arithmetic as incomplete: its record splits the major into eleven 'List A: <subject>' blocks with no stated units, against total_units 18. Its sibling Social and Behavioral Sciences 17911 (AA.GSB) passes as one 18-unit 'Completion requirement' block of 87 courses. This read prints both tabs' own words around the list headings and the unit figures, to see whether the page states one 18-unit choice across the subject lists before any reconcile step pools them. Two tabs, no model call.

outside_hosts.coursedog.com: Hartnell's catalog vendor hosts the catalog itself (hartnell.catalog.prod.coursedog.com) and its data (app.coursedog.com); the registry's catalog address is on this host.

questions.lists: How each tab words its major: whether one unit figure (18) governs all the subject lists together, and the words that introduce List A and each subject heading.
